title: Saving .swerepo.toml, also after changes, keeps people's comments and every key SWERepo doesn't know
assertion: Saving .swerepo.toml, including after SWERepo changed values and when a newer SWERepo saves, keeps comments on their own line and at the end of lines it changed, and every key SWERepo doesn't know, top-level, in a table it knows, or in a table of its own, with its value.

origin.text: Phase 1 behaviour, reviewed by Gemini in 3 rounds and strengthened after SeamSpec's reviewer explained two drafts (ADR-20261120-ecf7); proposed for the owner to approve.

status_reason: GitHub Copilot's review of PR #2 showed updating an existing record dropped comments and unknown keys inside it, which the rule promises to keep but its test didn't exercise. Code fixed in b827f00; the replacement's test updates an existing record.
